name: carmelosantana/coqui-toolkit-images
description: AI image generation and library management toolkit for Coqui — generate, preview, tag, categorize, and search images across OpenAI and Ollama backends.

suggest.ext-gd: Required for low-fidelity colored image previews in the REPL

php-agents.description: Generate, preview, organize, tag, and search AI-generated images using OpenAI and Ollama backends. Supports PNG metadata embedding, low-fidelity REPL previews, and workspace library management.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key for GPT Image 1.5 image generation.

OLLAMA_HOST.description: Optional Ollama host hint for local setup guidance. The current toolkit implementation shells out to the local `ollama` CLI for image generation.

COQUI_IMAGE_MODEL.description: Optional fallback image model in vendor/model format, for example openai/gpt-image-1.5 or ollama/x/z-image-turbo.
